item.name: Antitoxkit
entries: An {@item Antitoxkit|sw5e-phb|antitoxkit} contained a variety of wide-spectrum antidote hypospray injectors that were designed to neutralize all known poisons. A kit has five charges. As an action, you can administer a charge of the kit to cure a target of one poison affecting them or to give them {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to droids or constructs.

item.name: Aquatic rebreather
entries: Aquatic breathers are breath masks designed to operate underwater. While worn, the wearer can breathe both air and water.

item.name: Armormech's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Armstech's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Artificer's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Artificer's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Assault armor
entries: {@item Assault armor|sw5e-phb} improved on {@item Battle armor|sw5e-phb|battle armor}, with the benefit of micro-hydraulics that boost the efficacy of the operator. It offers better protection, but increased weight.

item.name: Assault cannon
entries: {@dice d12} energy damage. Properties: Burst 4; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 90/360); reload 4; strength 15; two-handed.

item.name: Astrotech's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Backpack
entries: A {@item Backpack|sw5e-phb|backpack} stores 30 lb., not exceeding 1 cubic foot.

item.name: Bandolier
entries: A {@item Bandolier|sw5e-phb|bandolier} is worn across the chest. It has 12 pockets that can each hold a single item that weighs less than 2.00 lb, such as a {@item Vibrodagger|sw5e-phb}, a fragmentation grenade, or a {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}. Once per turn, drawing an item from a {@item Bandolier|sw5e-phb|bandolier} does not require your object interaction.

item.name: Battle armor
entries: {@item Battle armor|sw5e-phb} is an armor that reduced weight, but restricts movement. The armor is commonly used by mercenaries, bounty hunters, soldiers, and civilians that live in dangerous areas.

item.name: Beam rifle
entries: 2d6 energy damage. Properties: Penetrating 2; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 150/600); reload 2; strength 15; two-handed.

item.name: Bedroll
entries: Utility ({@item Bedroll|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Binders
entries: {@item Binders|sw5e-phb} can be used to restrain a Small or Medium creature with appropriate appendages. Applying {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} takes an action, and the target must make a DC 14 Strength or Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (the target chooses the ability to use). A hostile creature makes this save with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. Breaking the {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} requires a DC 20 Strength check. Escaping them requires a DC 20 Dexterity check. A set of {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} comes with one key. Without the key, unlocking the {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} requires a DC 15 {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit} to force open. {@item Binders|sw5e-phb} have an AC of 10 and 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. Destroying the {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} frees the creature without harming it.

item.name: Biochemist's kit
entries: Biochemist's kits are used to create and enhance medpacs and other healing implements.

item.name: Biotech's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Bipod
entries: A bipod is a device mounted to a two-handed {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} that lacks the fixed property to offer increased stability while {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}. As an action, you can deploy or collapse the bipod. While deployed, you ignore the Strength requirement on the attached {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with the strength property while you are {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}, and your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced to 0. Additionally, while deployed and prone, you have a +10 bonus to {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being disarmed of the weapon.

item.name: Blanket
entries: Utility ({@item Blanket|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Blaster carbine
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 70/280); reload 16; two-handed.

item.name: Blaster pistol
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 50/200); reload 16.

item.name: Blaster rifle
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 105/420); reload 12; two-handed.

item.name: Bottle
entries: A {@item Bottle|sw5e-phb|bottle} stores 1 and 1/2 pints of liquid.

item.name: Bowcaster
entries: {@dice d10} energy damage. Properties: Burst 4; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 50/200); reload 4; strength 13; two-handed.

item.name: Burglar's Pack
entries: Costs 290 credits. Includes a {@item Backpack|sw5e-phb|backpack}, two glowrods, a {@item Hydrospanner|sw5e-phb|hydrospanner}, a {@item Fusion cutter|sw5e-phb|fusion cutter}, a {@item Chronometer|sw5e-phb|chronometer}, a {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook}, 5 days of field rations, and a {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen}.

item.name: Canteen
entries: A {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen} stores 4 pints of liquid.

item.name: Carbine rifle
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: Auto; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 90/360); rapid 3; reload 12; strength 11; two-handed.

item.name: Chakram
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Finesse; returning; thrown (range 30/90).

item.name: Chance cubes
entries: GamingSet ({@item Chance cubes|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Chef's kit
entries: Kit ({@item Chef's kit|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Chest
entries: A chest stores 300 lb., not exceeding 12 cubic feet.

item.name: Chronometer
entries: A {@item Chronometer|sw5e-phb|chronometer} is a device that measures and keeps linear time.

item.name: Clothes, common
entries: Clothing ({@item Clothes, common|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Clothes, costume
entries: Clothing ({@item Clothes, costume|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Clothes, dress uniform
entries: Clothing ({@item Clothes, dress uniform|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Clothes, fine
entries: Clothing ({@item Clothes, fine|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Clothes, traveler's
entries: Clothing ({@item Clothes, traveler's|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Code cylinder
entries: Code cylinders are security devices in the shape of short cylinders that contain coded information about their bearers and grant them access to secure areas.

item.name: Combat suit
entries: Combat suits are seen all over the galaxy, and can be found for sale by almost any merchant who dealt in weapons and armor. Many such suits are used by military organizations, such as the Galactic Republic's military, as well as by mercenaries, criminals, bounty hunters and even some Jedi.
The suit itself offers decent protection from most types of attacks while maintaining maximum flexibility and minimum weight. However this armor is only recommended for light skirmishes.

item.name: Comm jammer
entries: A device used to scramble and block transmissions from communications devices in a 300 foot radius. The device can be activated or deactivated as an action. Any creature sending incoming or outgoing communications within range must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check. On a failure, their communications are jammed until the {@item Comm jammer|sw5e-phb|comm jammer} is deactivated or they move out of its range. The {@item Comm jammer|sw5e-phb|comm jammer} lasts for 1 hour and can be recharged by connecting to a power source or by replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Commlink
entries: commlinks are simple handheld communication devices, fitted with microphones and receivers. Basic, personal commlinks have a range of up to 30 miles, but are reduced in dense, urban areas or areas of high level interference. The {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink} lasts for 10 hours and can be recharged by connecting to a power source or by replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Commlink, hands-free
entries: A hands-free {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink} functions as a {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink}, but can be installed in a helmet or worn independently, such as on your head or ear.

item.name: Composite armor
entries: {@item Composite armor|sw5e-phb} is a type of armored suit that offers a good balance of mobility and protection against most types of weapons. The micro-hydraulics of this type of powered armor provide the operator with protection, but are more bulky than mesh or weave armors. This type of armor is rarely seen outside of professional mercenaries' and soldiers' use.

item.name: Crate
entries: A crate stores 40 gallons of liquid or 4 cubic feet of solid.

item.name: Credit
entries: Credits come in a variety of denominations: from a single chit to cards loaded with incredible value. While the Republic and Empire have their own currencies, in most worlds they can be used interchangeably.

With ten credits, a character can buy a {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}, a stylus, or a {@item Glowrod|sw5e-phb|glowrod}. A skilled (but not exceptional) artisan can earn ten {@item credit|sw5e-phb|credits} a day. The credit is the standard unit of measure for wealth, even if the chit itself is not commonly used. When merchants discuss deals that involve goods or services worth hundreds or thousands of credits, the transactions don't usually involve the exchange of individual chits. Rather, the {@item Credit|sw5e-phb|credit} is a standard measure of value, and the actual exchange is in credit cards, letters of credit, or valuable goods.
A standard chit weighs about a third of an ounce, so fifty chits weigh a pound.

item.name: Cybertech's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Cycler rifle
entries: {@dice d8} kinetic damage. Properties: Rapid 2; reload 8; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 90/360); strength 11; two-handed.

item.name: Dart
entries: This {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} ammunition deals 1d6 kinetic damage on a hit.

item.name: Datacard
entries: A {@item Datacard|sw5e-phb|datacard} or data disk is a flat, hand-held device used in conjunction with a {@item Datapad|sw5e-phb|datapad} to store information.

item.name: Datacron
entries: A {@item Datacron|sw5e-phb|datacron} is a type of {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} that can be accessed by non-Force-sensitives and are mainly used to store encrypted data. They are complete with an interactive projection to access the information.

item.name: Datapad
entries: A {@item Datapad|sw5e-phb|datapad} is a small electronic device used for the input, storage and displaying of information. It features a holoprojective surface for 3D viewing.

item.name: Dejarik set
entries: GamingSet ({@item Dejarik set|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Demolitions kit
entries: Demolitions kits are used to create, enhance, and disarm explosives.

item.name: Diplomat's Pack
entries: Costs 330 credits. Includes a chest, a set of fine clothes, a {@item Datapad|sw5e-phb|datapad}, 5 datacards, a stylus, 5 days of field rations, and a {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen}.

item.name: Disguise kit
entries: Kit ({@item Disguise kit|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Doubleblade
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Double (1d6 kinetic); finesse; light.

item.name: Doublesaber
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: Double (1d8 energy); finesse; luminous.

item.name: Doubleshoto
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: Double (1d6 energy); finesse; light; luminous.

item.name: Doublesword
entries: {@dice d8} kinetic damage. Properties: Double (1d8 kinetic); finesse.

item.name: Drum
entries: MusicalInstrument (Drum).

item.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
entries: Costs 320 credits. Includes a {@item Backpack|sw5e-phb|backpack}, five glowrods, a {@item Fusion cutter|sw5e-phb|fusion cutter}, a {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook}, a {@item Chronometer|sw5e-phb|chronometer}, 10 days of field rations, a {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen}, and 50 feet of fibercord cable strapped to the side of it.

item.name: Emergency battery
entries: All non-expendable droids need recharging as they are used. The battery has ten uses. As an action, you can expend one use of the battery to stabilize a droid that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, without needing to make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check.

item.name: Emergency shelter
entries: This shelter comes packed in a 2-foot-long tube. When activated, the shelter deploys, expanding to full size in 1 minute. The shelter is 8 feet long, 8 feet wide, and 6 feet tall, and can house up to six Medium creatures. The shelter includes spikes that automatically mount to the ground, provided they can find purchase. The shelter comes with an integrated power generator, faint glowing lights in the interior which provide dim light, and creatures in the shelter are protected from the elements, including hot and cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide. The shelter's power generator lasts for seven days, after which it stops providing light. The shelter can be collapsed and restored over the course of 10 minutes.

item.name: Entertainer's Pack
entries: Costs 420 credits. Includes a {@item Backpack|sw5e-phb|backpack}, a {@item Bedroll|sw5e-phb|bedroll}, two costumes, two glowrods, 5 days of field rations, a {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen}, and a {@item Disguise kit|sw5e-phb|disguise kit}.

item.name: Enviro-suit
entries: Environment suits, atmospheric suits, or EVA suits, are pressure suits that enabled wearers to survive and operate in zero gravity space and other dangerous conditions.

item.name: Explorer's Pack
entries: Costs 250 credits. Includes a {@item Backpack|sw5e-phb|backpack}, a {@item Bedroll|sw5e-phb|bedroll}, a {@item Blanket|sw5e-phb|blanket}, a {@item Mess kit|sw5e-phb|mess kit}, two glowrods, a {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink}, 10 days of field rations, a {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen}, and 50 feet of fibercord cable strapped to the side of it.

item.name: Fiber armor
entries: {@item Fiber armor|sw5e-phb} is a type of armor that offers more protection than the lighter {@item Combat suit|sw5e-phb|combat suit}. {@item Fiber armor|sw5e-phb} is heavier overall than combat suits, and not quite as flexible, but many consider the trade-offs worthwhile. It is a good source of defense from physical attacks and light {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} fire.

item.name: Fibercord cable, 50 ft (rolled)
entries: Utility (Fibercord cable, 50 ft (rolled)).

item.name: Field rations (one day's)
entries: Ration packs consist of dry foods suitable for extended travel, and are used when other food is scarce. Each pack is divided into portions and can provide enough food for one person per day.

item.name: Flight suit
entries: Flight suits, or jumpsuits, are a type of outfit worn by pilots. They are worn in conjunction with flight helmets. They come in a variety of different colors and provide life support, and protect from hostile environments.

item.name: Flute
entries: MusicalInstrument (Flute).

item.name: Forgery kit
entries: Kit ({@item Forgery kit|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Friction-grip gear
entries: A special set of gloves and boots that allow the wearer to stick to and climb surfaces. While wearing these items, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and ceilings while leaving your hands free. You also gain a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

item.name: Fusion cutter
entries: A {@item Fusion cutter|sw5e-phb|fusion cutter} is a handheld cutting tool popular among technicians. It can cut through almost any reinforced material, given enough time. The internal {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} supplies an hour's worth of continuous operation.

item.name: Gadgeteer's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Gadgeteer's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Glowrod
entries: Glowrods create a beam of light illuminating the area around you in bright light for a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The {@item Glowrod|sw5e-phb|glowrod} lasts for 10 hours and can be recharged by connecting to a power source or by replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Grappling hook
entries: A {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook} allows a user to climb or ascend large objects. It can be mounted to a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}, belt, or elsewhere. It has a 50-foot length.

item.name: Great-saber
entries: 2d6 energy damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; luminous; two-handed.

item.name: Grenade, fragmentation
entries: Grenades can be set to detonate on impact or with a timer that causes them to explode on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). As an action, you can prime and throw a grenade at a point you can see within 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 2d10 kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: Grenade, gas
entries: Grenades can be set to detonate on impact or with a timer that causes them to explode on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). As an action, you can prime and throw a grenade at a point you can see within 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. The grenade explodes, filling the air in a 10-foot-radius sphere with yellow-green fog for 1 minute. The fog spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses it.

When a creature enters the fog or starts its turn there, it creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. The creature takes 2d6 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, on a failed save, the creature is {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb} while it is in the cloud. Droids, constructs and humanoids wearing appropriate protective equipment are unaffected.

item.name: Grenade, ion
entries: Grenades can be set to detonate on impact or with a timer that causes them to explode on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). As an action, you can prime and throw a grenade at a point you can see within 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 2d6 ion damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. Any electronics within the blast radius are disabled until rebooted.

item.name: Grenade, plasma
entries: Grenades can be set to detonate on impact or with a timer that causes them to explode on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). As an action, you can prime and throw a grenade at a point you can see within 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 2d10 energy damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: Headcomm
entries: A {@item Headcomm|sw5e-phb|headcomm} can be installed in a helmet or worn independently. It functions as a hands-free {@item commlink|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Heat generator
entries: Heat generators are special devices typically worn on belts that function as a portable, personal heat supply. Activating or deactivating the generator requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you are adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide. The generator lasts for 10 minutes and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Heavy Blaster rifle
entries: 2d4 energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 100/400); rapid 2; reload 8; strength 13; two-handed.

item.name: Heavy bowcaster
entries: {@dice d12} energy damage. Properties: Burst 2; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 90/360); reload 4; strength 17; two-handed.

item.name: Heavy carbine
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 60/240); rapid 4; reload 16; strength 11; two-handed.

item.name: Heavy exoskeleton
entries: Heavy exoskeletons are virtually the heaviest armor acquirable during the Galactic War. It is ideal for extreme combat situations that involved direct damage and also offers a very good level of protection in sacrifice of dexterity. Some consider it claustrophobic but that was the trade-off for safety.

item.name: Heavy physical shield
entries: AC +3.

item.name: Heavy pistol
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 45/180); reload 16.

item.name: Heavy repeater
entries: 2d4 energy damage. Properties: Auto; burst 4; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 80/320); rapid 4; reload 8; strength 13; two-handed.

item.name: Heavy shield generator
entries: AC +3.

item.name: Heavy shotgun
entries: 2d4 kinetic damage. Properties: Burst 2; reload 8; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 60/240); strength 13; two-handed.

item.name: Heavy slugpistol
entries: {@dice d8} kinetic damage. Properties: Rapid 8; reload 12; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 30/120).

item.name: Hidden blade
entries: {@dice d4} kinetic damage. Properties: Finesse; fixed; hidden; light.

item.name: Hold-out
entries: {@dice d4} energy damage. Properties: Hidden; light; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 30/120); reload 8.

item.name: Holocomm
entries: A {@item Holocomm|sw5e-phb|holocomm} is a communications unit that utilizes the HoloNet. It enables users to send and receive messages through holographic-based transmission networks.

item.name: Holocron
entries: Holocrons are information-storage devices used by force wielders that contain ancient lessons or valuable information in holographic form. They appear as palm-sized, glowing polyhedrons of crystalline material and hardware, and can only be activated and used through the power of the Force.

item.name: Holorecorder
entries: A {@item Holorecorder|sw5e-phb|holorecorder} is a device used to record and project holograms. Some droid models are equipped with internal holorecorders.

item.name: Holotrace device
entries: A {@item Holotrace device|sw5e-phb|holotrace device} is a wrist-worn gadget that can be used to trace a holographic transmission back to its source.

item.name: Homing beacon
entries: A {@item Homing beacon|sw5e-phb|homing beacon} is a device used to track starships or any other entity being transported. Homing beacons transmit using non-mass HoloNet transceivers able to be tracked through hyperspace. Homing beacons are small enough that they can easily be hidden inside a ship, or tucked into some crevice on its exterior.

item.name: Hunting rifle
entries: {@dice d10} kinetic damage. Properties: Reload 4; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 125/500); strength 11; two-handed.

item.name: Hydrospanner
entries: Utility ({@item Hydrospanner|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Ion cannon
entries: {@dice d10} ion damage. Properties: Auto; burst 4; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 90/360); reload 4; strength 15; two-handed.

item.name: Ion carbine
entries: {@dice d4} ion damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 60/240); reload 12; two-handed.

item.name: Ion pistol
entries: Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 40/160); reload 16.

item.name: Ion rifle
entries: {@dice d6} ion damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 80/320); reload 8; two-handed.

item.name: Jetpack
entries: Jetpacks are personal aerial transportation devices that allow the operator to fly into and through the air with great mobility. Activating or deactivating the {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. The {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} last for 1 minute per {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 10 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}.

item.name: Light physical shield
entries: AC +1.

item.name: Light pistol
entries: {@dice d4} energy damage. Properties: Light; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 40/160); reload 8.

item.name: Light repeater
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: Auto; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 50/200); rapid 5; reload 20; two-handed.

item.name: Light shield generator
entries: AC +1.

item.name: Light slugpistol
entries: {@dice d4} kinetic damage. Properties: Light; reload 8; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 35/140).

item.name: Lightaxe
entries: {@dice d12} energy damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; heavy; luminous; two-handed.

item.name: Lightblade
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: Finesse; hidden; luminous.

item.name: Lightclub
entries: {@dice d10} energy damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; heavy; luminous; two-handed.

item.name: Lightdagger
entries: {@dice d4} energy damage. Properties: Finesse; hidden; light; luminous; thrown (range 20/60).

item.name: Lightfoil
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: Finesse; hidden; luminous.

item.name: Lightsaber
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: Hidden; luminous; versatile (2d4).

item.name: Lightstaff
entries: 2d4 energy damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; luminous; reach; two-handed.

item.name: Lute
entries: MusicalInstrument (Lute).

item.name: Macrobinoculars
entries: {@item Macrobinoculars|sw5e-phb} are handheld viewing devices that allow users to observe distant objects. Some models are able to see into space from the surface of a planet.

item.name: Martial lightsaber
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: Hidden; luminous; versatile (1d10).

item.name: Mechanic's kit
entries: Mechanic's kits are used to craft and repair vehicles and starships.

item.name: Medium physical shield
entries: AC +2.

item.name: Medium shield generator
entries: AC +2.

item.name: Medpac
entries: A {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} is a quick-acting syringe filled with a concentrated dose of kolto. As an action, you can use this {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a beast or humanoid within 5 feet. The creature rolls one die equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + their Constitution modifier (minimum of one hit point). If the creature has Hit Dice of different sizes, use whichever Hit Die size they have the most of.

item.name: Mesh armor
entries: Providing solid protection for a minimal cost, {@item Mesh armor|sw5e-phb|mesh armor} is considered excellent protection for entrenched troops or guards. However, this protection comes at a cost of mobility, limiting its uses by rapidly advancing infantry. Still, it provides more mobility than {@item Battle armor|sw5e-phb|battle armor}.

item.name: Mess kit
entries: This box contains a cup and simple cutlery. The box clamps together, and one side can be used as a cooking pan and the other as a plate or shallow bowl.

item.name: Mine, fragmentation
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item Remote detonator|sw5e-phb|remote detonator}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which arms at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 2d10 kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: Mine, gas
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a remote

item.name: Mine, incendiary
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item Remote detonator|sw5e-phb|remote detonator}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which arms at the start of your next turn. When detonated, the mine sets the ground in a 15-foot radius ablaze for 1 minute. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

When a creature enters the fire or starts its turn there, it creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. The creature takes 2d8 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Mirror
entries: Utility ({@item Mirror|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Missile, fragmentation
entries: This {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} ammunition deals 1d6 kinetic damage on a hit. Additionally, hit or miss, the missile then explodes. The target and each creature within 5 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 1d10 kinetic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

item.name: Net
entries: A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb} until it is freed. A net has no effect on formless or Huge or larger creatures. A creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The net has an AC of 10, 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, and immunity to all damage not dealt by melee weapons. Destroying the net frees the creature without harming it and immediately ends the net's effects. While a creature is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb} by a net, you can make no further attacks with it.

item.name: Ommni box
entries: MusicalInstrument ({@item Ommni box|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Pazaak deck
entries: GamingSet ({@item Pazaak deck|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Pikesaber
entries: {@dice d10} energy damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; luminous; reach; two-handed.

item.name: Pitcher
entries: A {@item Pitcher|sw5e-phb|pitcher} stores 1 gallon of liquid.

item.name: Pocket scrambler
entries: A {@item Pocket scrambler|sw5e-phb|pocket scrambler} is a simple add-on to any {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink} that automatically encodes any messages sent out. The transmitted message can only be read by a device equipped with a matched scrambler.

item.name: Poison
entries: As an action, you can use the poison in this vial to coat one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}, one {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge}, or one {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} dart. A creature hit by the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb} weapon must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 2d4 poison damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute before drying.

item.name: Poisoner's kit
entries: Kit ({@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Pouch
entries: A pouch stores 6.00 lb., not exceeding 1/5 cubic foot.

item.name: Power cell
entries: Weapons with this property are fueled by {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, which must be loaded in order to fire the weapon. A {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} fuels a number of attacks equal to the weapon's reload number.

item.name: Priest's Pack
entries: Costs 275 credits. Includes a {@item Backpack|sw5e-phb|backpack}, a {@item Blanket|sw5e-phb|blanket}, two glowrods, a {@item Datapad|sw5e-phb|datapad}, a {@item Traumakit|sw5e-phb|traumakit}, 5 days of field rations, and a {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen}.

item.name: Projector canister, cryo
entries: When triggered, this {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} ammunition produces a beam of carbonite energy in a line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a 15-foot cone. A single fuel canister holds enough fuel for three attacks in a line or a single attack in a cone. Each creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d4 cold damage and gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, that creature is frozen in carbonite for 1 hour. If you lack proficiency in the {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher}, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.

item.name: Projector canister, incendiary
entries: When triggered, this {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} ammunition produces a burst of flame in a line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a 15-foot cone. A single fuel canister holds enough fuel for three attacks in a line or a single attack in a cone. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 1d8 fire damage or half as much on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. If you lack proficiency in the {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher}, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.

item.name: Ram, portable
entries: You can use a portable ram to break down doors. When doing so, you gain a +4 bonus on the Strength check. One other character can help you use the ram, giving you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on this check.

item.name: Remote detonator
entries: A small handhold device with a single button, used to activate explosives. Over the course of 1 minute, you can pair the detonator with up to two mines within 10 feet. As an action, you can remotely detonate all of the paired mines. You must be within 30 feet of the mines to detonate them.

item.name: Repair kit
entries: A {@item Repair kit|sw5e-phb|repair kit} included the basic tools needed to repair a droid or construct after being damaged in combat. The kit has three uses. As an action, you can expend one use of the kit to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a droid or construct within 5 feet. The creature rolls one die equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal

item.name: Repeating blaster
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: Auto; burst 4; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 75/300); rapid 4; reload 8; strength 11; two-handed.

item.name: Respirator
entries: A {@item Respirator|sw5e-phb|respirator}, or breath mask, is a portable device that includes 1 hour's worth of oxygen. The {@item Respirator|sw5e-phb|respirator} is designed to function in all environments.

item.name: Restraining bolt
entries: Restraining bolts are small, cylindrical devices that can be affixed to a droid in order to limit its functions and enforce its obedience. When inserted, a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} restricts the droid from any movement its master does not desire, and also forced it to respond to signals produced by a hand-held control unit.

Installing a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} takes 1 minute. The droid must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A hostile droid makes this save with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. On a successful save, the {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} overloads and is rendered useless. On a failed save, the {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} is correctly installed, and the control unit can be used to actively control the droid. While the control unit is inactive, the droid can act freely but it can not attempt to remove the {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt}.

item.name: Rocket boots
entries: {@item Rocket boots|sw5e-phb} are a form of rocket propulsion system affixed to a pair of boots instead of being worn on the back like a standard {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack}. Activating or deactivating the boots requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet. The {@item Rocket boots|sw5e-phb|rocket boots} last for 1 minute and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}.

item.name: Rotary cannon
entries: {@dice d10} energy damage. Properties: Auto; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 75/300); rapid 2; reload 8; strength 13; two-handed.

item.name: Sabacc deck
entries: GamingSet ({@item Sabacc deck|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Saberwhip
entries: {@dice d4} energy damage. Properties: Finesse; hidden; luminous; reach.

item.name: Scattergun
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Burst 2; reload 8; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 30/120); strength 11.

item.name: Scholar's Pack
entries: Costs 290 credits. Includes a {@item Backpack|sw5e-phb|backpack}, a {@item Datapad|sw5e-phb|datapad}, 5 datacards, a stylus, a {@item Holorecorder|sw5e-phb|holorecorder}, 5 days of field rations, and a {@item Canteen|sw5e-phb|canteen}.

item.name: Security kit
entries: Security kits are used to bypass physical locks.

item.name: Shield
entries: Shields come in varying weights, sizes, and materials. Light {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} are smaller and mounted to the forearm, while medium and heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} are held in hand. You can only benefit from one {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} at a time.
{@b {@i Physical Shields.}} Physical {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} are made entirely of physical materials. They are cheaper than their generator counterparts, but heavier.

{@b {@i Shield Generators.}} {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} generators are made almost entirely of energy barriers. Medium and heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generators have a physical handheld component from which the barrier emanates; medium {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generators are orbs that are slightly larger than a fist, while heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generators project from a large cross.
See {@item Light physical shield|sw5e-phb}, {@item Medium physical shield|sw5e-phb}, {@item Heavy physical shield|sw5e-phb}, and {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generators in the equipment chapter.

item.name: Shotgun
entries: 2d4 kinetic damage. Properties: Burst 2; reload 4; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 30/120); strength 11; two-handed.

item.name: Shotosaber
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: Finesse; hidden; light; luminous.

item.name: Shovel
entries: Utility ({@item Shovel|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Slicer's kit
entries: Slicer's kits can bypass computerized defenses and locks.

item.name: Slug cartridge
entries: Weapons with this property fire slug cartridges, which must be loaded in order to fire the weapon.

item.name: Slugpistol
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Rapid 8; reload 16; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 40/160); strength 11.

item.name: Slugthrower
entries: {@dice d8} kinetic damage. Properties: Reload 12; {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} (range 105/420); two-handed.

item.name: Sniper rifle
entries: {@dice d12} energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 150/600); reload 2; strength 13; two-handed.

item.name: Splitsaber
entries: 2d4 energy damage. Properties: Double (2d4 energy); interlocking; luminous.

item.name: Splitshoto
entries: {@dice d8} energy damage. Properties: Double (1d8 energy); interlocking; light; luminous.

item.name: Stealth field generator
entries: {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} field generators are special devices typically worn on belts that function as a portable, personal cloaking device. Activating or deactivating the generator requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} that rely on sight. The generator lasts for 1 minute and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}. This effect ends early if you make an attack or cast a force or {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

item.name: Stylus pen
entries: A {@item Stylus pen|sw5e-phb|stylus pen} is designed to write on both solid surfaces and touch screen interfaces.

item.name: Subrepeater
entries: {@dice d6} energy damage. Properties: Auto; rapid 4; light; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 30/120); reload 16; strength 11.

item.name: Techaxe
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Light; thrown (range 25/75).

item.name: Techblade
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Finesse; light.

item.name: Techstaff
entries: 2d4 kinetic damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; double (2d4 kinetic); light.

item.name: Tent, two-person
entries: Utility ({@item Tent, two-person|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Thermal detonator
entries: Thermal detonators are unique in that can only be turned off by whoever turned them on. They can be set to detonate on impact or with a timer that causes them to explode on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). As an action, you can prime and throw a grenade at a point you can see within 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 2d6 fire and 2d10 kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. Additionally, on a failed save, the creature is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

item.name: Tinker's implements
entries: Tool ({@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb}).

item.name: Tracker utility vest
entries: A utility vest is a sleeveless item of clothing that includes several evenly-distributed pockets, popular among hunters, smugglers, and adventurers. The vest is made of leathery, hide material to resist rips, corrosion and water. The wearer can carry up to 10 light items (up to 1.00 lb each) without increasing their total encumbrance.

item.name: Trapper's kit
entries: Trapper's kits can create, disarm, and disassemble traps.

item.name: Traumakit
entries: A common {@item Traumakit|sw5e-phb|traumakit} is stocked with essentials for the treatment of wounds. A {@item Traumakit|sw5e-phb|traumakit} has five uses. As an action, you can expend a use of the kit to stabilize a creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, without needing to make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}) check.

item.name: Tripod
entries: A {@item Tripod|sw5e-phb|tripod} is a device mounted to a two-handed {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} that lacks the fixed property to offer increased stability. Over the course of 1 minute, you can deploy or collapse the {@item Tripod|sw5e-phb|tripod}. While deployed, you ignore the Strength requirement on the attached {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with the strength property, and your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced to 0. Additionally, while deployed, you have a +10 bonus to {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being disarmed of the weapon.

item.name: Vibroaxe
entries: {@dice d12} kinetic damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; heavy; two-handed.

item.name: Vibroblade
entries: {@dice d8} kinetic damage. Properties: Versatile (1d10).

item.name: Vibrodagger
entries: {@dice d4} kinetic damage. Properties: Finesse; light; thrown (range 20/60).

item.name: Vibrodart
entries: Due to their diminutive size, vibrodarts make ineffective melee weapons. Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with them are made at {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

item.name: Vibroknuckler
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Hidden; light.

item.name: Vibromace
entries: {@dice d10} kinetic damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; heavy; two-handed.

item.name: Vibropike
entries: {@dice d10} kinetic damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; reach; two-handed.

item.name: Vibrorapier
entries: {@dice d8} kinetic damage. Properties: Finesse.

item.name: Vibrospear
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Thrown (range 25/75); versatile (2d4).

item.name: Vibrostaff
entries: {@dice d6} kinetic damage. Properties: Versatile (2d4).

item.name: Vibrosword
entries: 2d6 kinetic damage. Properties: Dexterity 11; two-handed.

item.name: Vibrowhip
entries: {@dice d4} kinetic damage. Properties: Finesse; reach.

item.name: Weave armor
entries: {@item Weave armor|sw5e-phb} was constructed from a mesh of metal or composite plates and a padded jumpsuit. Variants of the armor included less plates and more padding for a lighter, though less protect-ive armor, and heavier plating with molded pieces to fit the wearer. Though the armor was available unmodified, most users personalized their armor.

item.name: Wrist launcher
entries: Rather than traditional {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} fires specialized projectiles in the form of darts, small missiles, or specialized canisters.
item.ammoType: darts, small missiles, or specialized canisters

item.name: Wristblaster
entries: {@dice d4} energy damage. Properties: Disguised; fixed; light; {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cell} (range 30/120); reload 8.

item.name: Wristpad
entries: A {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} is a harness with an integrated {@item Datapad|sw5e-phb|datapad} and holoprojector interface that fits on the forearm and includes self-charging battery packs.
